tax.text: He supports raising the payroll tax cap for high earners and restoring health coverage subsidies and Medicaid funding.
tax.quote: I'll block cuts to Social Security, defend workers’ pensions, and lift the cap so high earners pay in on all of their income.

wages.text: He supports raising the federal minimum wage and passing the PRO Act to protect workers organizing unions.
wages.quote: Raise the federal minimum wage so that working a full time job can support a family

trade.text: He proposes rolling back tariffs on construction materials to reduce new-home costs.
trade.quote: Make new housing more affordable by rolling back the tariffs on lumber and materials that are adding thousands of dollars to the cost of building a new home

debt.text: He says he would block Social Security cuts and defend workers’ pensions.
debt.quote: I'll block cuts to Social Security, defend workers’ pensions, and lift the cap so high earners pay in on all of their income.

schools.text: He supports fully funding public schools and protecting the Department of Education.
schools.quote: We need to fully fund our public schools, restore the value of Pell Grants, and invest in technical and vocational training.

abortion.text: He supports reproductive freedom and says politicians should not interfere with a woman’s health care decisions.
abortion.quote: We need to protect reproductive freedom and a woman's right to reproductive health care.

health.text: He supports restoring ACA subsidies, reversing Medicaid cuts, and creating a public health insurance option.
health.quote: Create a public option so families have a real choice and insurers have to compete on price

energy.text: He supports investing in clean energy and a more resilient grid to address climate change.
energy.quote: We need to invest in clean energy, build a more resilient grid, protect Lake Michigan and our drinking water from contamination, clean up PFAS, and make the polluters pay for it.

tax.text: He said tax increases do not help families and workers.
tax.quote: Policies that eliminate job opportunities, bailout mismanaged states, and increase taxes do not help families and workers.

wages.text: He voted against the Raise the Wage Act, which proposed increasing the federal minimum wage.
wages.quote: Jul 18, 2019, 12:01 PM | 116th Congress, 1st Session Vote Question: On Passage Raise the Wage Act

trade.text: In a 2025 listening session, he supported the president’s tariffs policy while describing a goal of reciprocal trade and negotiations.
trade.quote: I support allowing the president to play this out--to negotiate these agreements,

debt.text: He says he is committed to protecting Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: Steil is committed to protecting Social Security and Medicare.

housing.text: He co-led housing legislation to increase supply and said reducing red tape can make it easier to build homes.
housing.quote: By cutting through red tape and empowering local decision makers to increase supply, we can reduce costs and make it easier for families to purchase a home.

schools.text: He signed a letter urging Wisconsin to participate in a federal tax-credit scholarship program.
schools.quote: Wisconsin should seize this opportunity to empower parents and expand access to quality education for every child.

safety.text: His campaign says he will work with law enforcement to keep communities safe.
safety.quote: Steil will always work with law enforcement to ensure our communities are safe and secure.

immigration.text: He has called for securing the border and supporting policies to stop fentanyl flows and human trafficking.
immigration.quote: We must secure our border. Steil is working to secure the border by supporting policies to stop the flow of illicit fentanyl and end the human trafficking crisis.

guns.text: He describes himself as a strong advocate of Second Amendment rights.
guns.quote: I am a strong advocate of our Second Amendment rights. I am also a gun owner.

abortion.text: His campaign says he is a strong supporter of life and supports access to IVF.
abortion.quote: He supports access to IVF and is a strong supporter of life.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Steil voted against a motion to recommit the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, helping the bill advance to passage.
gender.quote:
Vote Question: On Motion to Recommit

Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

cannabis.text: He voted against the MORE Act, a bill to federally legalize marijuana.
cannabis.quote: Roll Call 107 | Bill Number: H. R. 3617

health.text: He said the federal government should not dictate individual health care needs.
health.quote: We can't afford to have Washington bureaucrats and the federal government dictating individual health care needs.

energy.text: Steil voted against the Climate Action Now Act and said federal regulations increase energy costs.
energy.quote: Heavy-handed federal regulations drive up energy costs. Instead, we must encourage technology developments to address climate change.

voting.text: He introduced election reforms requiring voter ID, cleaner voter rolls, and citizenship verification.
voting.quote: Americans should be confident their elections are being run with integrity - including commonsense voter ID requirements, clean voter rolls, and citizenship verification,
